notes.title: Fix Physics for very light setups (lol)
notes.content:
- Fix PID flyaway for light quads (5" Racer), caused by previous update
- Spinning propeller looks a bit better now
- Fixed kp/h typo
- Added option to offset stick overlay so it's visible when cropping to 16:9

notes.title: Fix Physics for heavy setups
notes.content: - Fixed low PID authority, causing heavy drones or high rates to feel very sluggish

notes.title: Crash Physics & Turtle mode
notes.content:
- Added realistic crash and collision physics
- Added Turtle mode

notes.title: Stick overlay
notes.content:
- Added Stick overlay (works while spectating too!)
- Fixed input device selector

notes.title: All maps in offline mode
notes.content:
- All maps can now be selected when playing offline
- Added experimental custom map support

notes.title: DJI Controller support
notes.content:
- Added "DJI endpoint scaling" option to controller setup
- Various behind the scenes stuff in preparation for future updates

notes.title: Racing Mode Beta
notes.content:
- Added new "Racing plains" map
- Added new Racing mode with online Leaderboards and Medals (available only on Racing plains map for now)
- Added new Racing Drone (yes I need to fix the 3D model)

notes.title: Small bug fixes
notes.content:
- Removed motion blur effect for now because it was causing issues with other effects (MSAA), making the end result look bad
- Fixed OSD messages staying on screen when they shouldn't

notes.title: Subtle realism part 1
notes.content:
- Limit PID authority and rotational acceleration
- Motors now change speed based on stick input other than throttle
- Rapid Yaw moves are more realistic now and result in "Yaw jump"
- Sound is also affected by changes above
- Sound is pitched slightly higher at high RPMs
- Added subtle motion blur

notes.title: Beginner tutorial and ARM switch
notes.content:
- Added tutorial for new pilots to learn the controls
- Performance improvements for Furniture store map
- Added ARM switch to the controller setup ("switch" for RC radios and "toggle" for Gamepads)

notes.title: New in-game menu and physics settings
notes.content:
- Added new pause menu
- Added Rates setup menu with graphs and shit
- Added new Beginner Drone with easy to fly physics settings
- Added Physics settings to allow dialing in cornering and drag
- Tweaked default drag settings slightly
- Audio volume can now be changed while in game

notes.title: New map: Blue furnitore store from sweden 🇸🇪
New map fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed a few bugs on the new triangle bando map
- Added dirt to all glass windows to improve visibility

notes.title: New Map!
notes.content:
- Added "Triangle bando" map
- Fixed quad weight not saving

Map still needs some work but I wanted to get an early version out before the weekend :)

notes.title: Patch notes March 13th 2025
notes.content:
- Adjusted default physics settings slightly, should feel less floaty or sticky now
- KISS and Betaflight rates can now be configured
- Map got some new textures and graffitis
- Upgraded the game engine to the latest version (Godot 4.3 -> 4.4)
- Adjusted lighting and shadows
- Potato graphics mode is now even more potato and should run on any PC
- Optimized game files to require less space
- All available radio channels can now be used (ARM and Respawn switches coming soon, too!)
- Spectating in multiplayer is a lot smoother now
